summary.name: StudyCrumb Paraphrasing Tool
summary.one_liner: A free online paraphrasing tool from StudyCrumb that rewrites pasted text (sentences, paragraphs, essays or articles) using AI, with no account required.
use_cases: Rewording an essay or paper to avoid plagiarism
Paraphrasing a single sentence or paragraph
Rewriting an article for writers or editors
Fixing grammar while rephrasing English text
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web tool where the user pastes text into a field, presses "Paraphrase", and receives a rewritten version within seconds. It is presented as handling sentences, paragraphs, essays and articles, and claims to preserve the original meaning. The page says no account or registration is needed and that the tool has no word limit, although one FAQ entry limits essays to 2500 words. The page also says the tool checks for repetitiveness, similarity to the original, plagiarism, unnatural wording and grammar. It also promotes paid human essay-writing services, which are separate from the free tool.
notable: Claims no sign-up, no account and no word limit for the free paraphraser
Separate modes for sentences, paragraphs, essays and articles
Says it uses AI to check for plagiarism, similarity, grammar and changed context
Also promotes paid essay-writing services and other free tools such as a summarizer and conclusion maker
caveats: One FAQ says essays are limited to 2500 words, which conflicts with the claim of no word limit
The page is heavily promotional, and the 100% unique and plagiarism-free claims are not independently verified
Upsell links to paid writing services appear throughout the page
